# Copier options

All questions live in `template/copier.yml`.

## Meta

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `_min_copier_version` | `9.4.0` |
| `_answers_file` | `.copier-answers.yml` |
| `_subdirectory` | `frontend` if `stack=frontend` else `backend` |

## Validators

- `project_slug`, `first_service`: `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]+$`

## Shared

| Question | Choices / default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `stack` | `backend` (default) \| `frontend` | Selects template subdirectory |
| `project_name` | default `My Platform` | Human title |
| `project_slug` | lowercase + dashes (from name) | Machine name / package hints |
| `ai_tools` | multiselect: claude, cursor (default both) | Emits `CLAUDE.md` / `.claude` and/or `.cursor/rules` |

## Backend

| Question | When | Choices / default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `repo_layout` | `stack == backend` | `monorepo` (default) \| `polyrepo_service` \| `polyrepo_kit` | Workspace vs single service vs kit publisher |
| `architecture` | monorepo | `monolith` (default) \| `microservices` | One service vs many; OpenAPI break check for micro |
| `first_service` | not kit | default `core-api` | First scaffolded service name |
| `messaging` | not kit | `none` (default) \| `kafka` | Compose broker, FastStream, outbox, contracts |
| `platform_profile` | not kit | `saas` (default) \| `api` | Local IdP/Redis/tenancy/entitlements vs external JWT only |
| `repo_manager` | monorepo | `none` (default) \| `nx` \| `moon` | Affected CI / project graph (`dx` always available) |
| `kit_git_url` | polyrepo_service | default GitHub placeholder | Pin platform-kit (https/ssh URL — **not** `git@host:path` scp form) |
| `kit_version` | polyrepo_service | default `v0.1.0` | Git tag to pin |
| `python_version` | backend | `3.12` (default) \| `3.13` | `.python-version` + requires-python |

## Frontend

| Question | Choices / default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `api_base_url` | `http://localhost:8001` | Seeded into Vite env |
| `default_locale` | `en` (default) \| `ja` | Initial i18n locale |

## Derived flags (not asked)

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `is_microservices` | polyrepo service **or** monorepo microservices |
| `has_kit_source` | kit lives in-repo (not polyrepo service) |
| `is_saas` | `platform_profile == saas` |

## Decision cheat sheet

```text
Need one deployable API with auth/billing?
  → monorepo + monolith + saas + messaging none

Need many services + events?
  → monorepo + microservices + kafka + nx|moon

Kit owned by a platform team, services in other repos?
  → polyrepo_kit  +  polyrepo_service (pin kit tag)

UI only?
  → stack=frontend
```
